# BlendIn

> BlendIn is an AI facilitator that turns networking events from random encounters into designed connections. Its conversational assistant "Blendy" interviews each participant in 5–8 minutes — via WhatsApp, web chat or phone — builds a structured 7-dimension profile, and composes event tables by complementarity, seating people who offer what others are looking for.

BlendIn is a product of PIIRZ Digital Limited (Malta). It is privacy-first ("GDPR by design"): explicit consent, automatic data deletion, and proprietary in-house matching and routing. The interview and interface are available in Italian, English and French.

## How it works
- **Conversational profiling:** Blendy interviews each participant in 5–8 minutes, no forms, by text or voice.
- **7 profile dimensions:** sector, business stage, skills, short-term goals (90 days), what you can offer, what you are looking for, and relational style.
- **Complementarity matching:** people are matched by what they complement in each other, not by similarity — those who offer what another is seeking sit at the same table.
- **Automatic table composition:** each table gets a quality score; the organiser can review and adjust it.
- **Organiser dashboard:** real-time session monitoring, table composition and matching analytics.

## Plans
- Free, Connect and Pro tiers, plus a White Label option for organisers. Details and pricing are shown on the site.
